name: perspective-infinity-grid
title: Perspective Infinity Grid
description: Classic 80s synthwave perspective vanishing point wireframe plane receding into the horizon.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Retro
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: Neon On Dark

## Rules

- Passive Perspective Wireframe: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
